note: Card values (health, block, resist, damage, dodge difficulty, behaviour decks, encounter line-ups) are the printed values of the 2017 core set as recorded in the public DSBG-Shuffle data set (github.com/DanDuhon/DSBG-Shuffle); threat, range, movement and targeting were read from the card faces. Range 9 stands for unlimited range. The other 2017 sets: enemy behaviour was read from re-drawn data cards and checked against a community table (work/phase7/enemy_cards_web.md); encounter line-ups are the author's, bosses' decks and special rules as the manuscript's chapter 17 states them. An encounter's crystal lizards are counted but not played. The 2022 sets and the Executioner's Chariot: enemy cards read from re-drawn data cards and a community table (work/phase7/cards_2022_web.md), as printed for the 2022 rules and not as the manuscript's revised cards, whose values are not to hand; a leap is played as a move of four nodes and Resurrect is not played. Encounter line-ups of the two 2022 sets are the public data set's and their printed special rules and objectives are not played; the Executioner's Chariot line-ups are the author's. The four 2022 bosses are played from the public behaviour data under the general boss rules (a deck of four for a mini-boss, five for a main boss), without any special rule of their own.
